steps.title: Stack in the middle
steps.rule: Everyone waits in the centre for Grotesquerie: Act 3.

steps.title: Lean toward your platforms
steps.rule: Your growth's arrow decides your platform, but the layout isn't shown yet: wait halfway between your cardinal platform and your intercardinal one. The support and DPS with the same arrow share a platform.

steps.title: Take your platform
steps.cue: the snakes show which squares stay (Grand Entrance)
steps.rule: Stand on the platform your arrow points away from, so your tower is thrown onto the next one and you soak the tower thrown at yours. Cardinal platforms: East arrow on the west platform, West on east, North on south, South on north. Intercardinal platforms, towers go clockwise: East arrow north-west, South north-east, West south-east, North south-west.

steps.title: Bait the snake heads
steps.rule: When the floor comes back, walk around the holes to your bait spot. The tanks stand closest to the snake head on their side (main tank west, off tank east); everyone else stays further from the heads than the tanks.

MainTank.rule: Be the closest to the west snake head: north-west with cardinal platforms, about 9m west of the centre, a little north, with intercardinal ones.

OffTank.rule: Be the closest to the east snake head: north-east with cardinal platforms, about 9m east of the centre, a little north, with intercardinal ones.

RegenHealer.rule: Wait just west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Wait just east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Cardinal platforms: just north of the centre, west side. Intercardinal: the outer corner of your platform.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Cardinal platforms: just north of the centre, east side. Intercardinal: the outer corner of your platform.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Cardinal platforms: about 11m west of the centre. Intercardinal: the outer corner of your platform.

CasterDps.rule: Cardinal platforms: about 9m east of the centre. Intercardinal: the outer corner of your platform.

steps.title: Spread for Venomous Scourge
steps.rule: Venomous Scourge hits the three players furthest east and the three furthest west: tanks stack in the middle, and the other six spread three per side, apart from each other.

MainTank.rule: Stack with the off tank in the middle (a little north of it with cardinal platforms).

OffTank.rule: Stack with the main tank in the middle (a little north of it with cardinal platforms).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Cardinal platforms: north-west. Intercardinal: stay on the outer corner of your platform.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Cardinal platforms: north-east. Intercardinal: stay on the outer corner of your platform.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Cardinal platforms: the west wall. Intercardinal: stay on the outer corner of your platform.

CasterDps.rule: Cardinal platforms: the east wall. Intercardinal: stay on the outer corner of your platform.
